mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE days AS ( SELECT #{from} AS stat_date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM days WHERE stat_date < #{to} ) SELECT days.stat_date, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(u.actual_fee_amount * TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(u.actual_start_at, days.stat_date), LEAST(u.actual_end_at, DATE_ADD(days.stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY))) / NULLIF(u.actual_minutes, 0)), 0), 2) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(u.actual_start_at, days.stat_date), LEAST(u.actual_end_at, DATE_ADD(days.stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)))), 0) AS minutes FROM days LEFT JOIN court_usage_record u ON u.settlement_status <> 'VOID' AND u.actual_start_at < DATE_ADD(days.stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND u.actual_end_at > days.stat_date GROUP BY days.stat_date ORDER BY days.stat_date

WITH RECURSIVE days AS ( SELECT #{from} AS stat_date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(stat_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM days WHERE stat_date < #{to} ) SELECT days.stat_date, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.total_amount), 0), 2) AS amount, COUNT(so.sales_order_id) AS order_count FROM days LEFT JOIN sales_order so ON so.payment_status = 'PAID' AND DATE(so.paid_at) = days.stat_date GROUP BY days.stat_date ORDER BY days.stat_date

SELECT c.court_id, c.court_name, c.court_number, c.operational_status, c.hourly_rate, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(u.actual_start_at, #{dayStart}), LEAST(u.actual_end_at, #{dayEnd}))), 0) AS minutes, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(u.actual_fee_amount * TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, GREATEST(u.actual_start_at, #{dayStart}), LEAST(u.actual_end_at, #{dayEnd})) / NULLIF(u.actual_minutes, 0)), 0), 2) AS amount FROM court c LEFT JOIN court_usage_record u ON u.court_id = c.court_id AND u.settlement_status <> 'VOID' AND u.actual_start_at < #{dayEnd} AND u.actual_end_at > #{dayStart} GROUP BY c.court_id, c.court_name, c.court_number, c.operational_status, c.hourly_rate ORDER BY c.court_id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM court) AS total_courts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM court WHERE operational_status = 'OPEN') AS open_courts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM court_slot s JOIN court c ON c.court_id = s.court_id WHERE s.slot_start <= #{now} AND s.slot_end > #{now} AND s.slot_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.operational_status = 'OPEN') AS free_courts_now, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.court_id) FROM court_slot s WHERE s.slot_start <= #{now} AND s.slot_end > #{now} AND s.slot_status = 'IN_USE') AS in_use_courts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM court_slot WHERE DATE(slot_start) = #{date} AND slot_status IN ('BOOKED', 'IN_USE')) AS booked_slots_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE role = 'MEMBER') AS total_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking WHERE start_at >= #{dayStart} AND start_at < #{dayEnd}) AS today_bookings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking WHERE start_at >= #{dayStart} AND start_at < #{dayEnd} AND status = 'COMPLETED') AS today_completed_bookings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT') AS pending_bookings
